observations: With WithLastSeenRetention at InterestReapGrace+InterestRefreshAge (15 min), the session cache's lastSeen records and revision fences now live 15 min after a session leaves, instead of one TTL (5 min). That is about three times as many dead-session entries, still bounded by session churn, and the expiry heap removes them (TestLastSeenRetentionKeepsTheRecordAndFenceThatLong).
